DAEの整合初期化と離散残差、Robertson保存制約DAEと公式IDA保存値、振り子の指数低減・拘束ドリフト・明示安定化。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 解説と位置付け 解説章を読む この例の前提 index-1の例では代数拘束のJacobianが選んだ解枝で正則で、Newton反復が固定基準を満たす必要があります。 後退Eulerの残差を解き、微分行と代数行の尺度を入力で指定します。整合初期値と不整合入力の拒否を別に確認します。 位置拘束の振り子はindex-3系です。追加例は微分拘束に基づくODEと拘束誤差の安定化を扱い、汎用高index DAEソルバーではありません。 公式IDAの保存済み印字値との比較と、新たに実行したRadau/BDF/DOP853参照を区別します。IDA本体の新規実行はありません。 境界条件: 空間境界はありません。代数拘束と整合した初期状態・初期微分が初期値問題の条件です。 単位系: 例は無次元です。微分残差と代数残差の行は明示した尺度を使い、生の残差ノルムが同じ単位を持つとは限りません。 小規模な専用実装と実測検証 追加固定例：index-1 See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Read the formulation Read the chapter Assumptions for this example For the index-one examples, the algebraic constraint Jacobian must be nonsingular on the selected branch and Newton iterations must satisfy fixed criteria. Backward-Euler residuals use explicit differential and algebraic row scales. Consistent initialization and rejection of inconsistent input are checked separately. The position-constrained pendulum is index three. Its examples use an underlying ODE and constraint-error stabilization, not a general high-index DAE solver. Comparisons with stored official IDA output are distinct from newly executed Radau/BDF/DOP853 references. The IDA executable is not newly run. Boundaries: There is no spatial boundary. Algebraic constraints and consistent initial state/derivative data are part of the initial-value formulation. Units: Examples are nondimensional. Differential and algebraic residual rows use explicitly declared scales; their unscaled norms need not have the same units. Small dedicated implementations and measured checks Additional fixed examples: Consistent initialization and discrete residuals for an index-one DAE, Robertson conservation DAE and stored official IDA values, Index reduction, constraint drift and explicit stabilization for a pendulum. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. One authored positive branch and fixed BE runs; no IDA execution or general DAE-solver qualification. Only two official SUNDIALS v7.1.1 printed rows; zero new IDA executions, with no long-time chemistry or general DAE-performance claim. No asymptotic-convergence or all-original-accuracy-goals claim is made for this fixed schedule. No projection, normalization or SHAKE/RATTLE; no general index-three-solver or symplecticity claim. These supplements are separate from the shared 22-case registry and do not verify every variant of a named method. Scope and remaining work Scope is limited to small fixed systems and inputs. The coarse Robertson schedule does not meet the original temporal accuracy/refinement goals; those false decisions are retained and shown. Underlying ODEs based on differentiated constraints can drift from the original constraint. General index handling, large sparse DAEs and convergence for arbitrary inputs are unverified.
